resources.string: Encrypted backups to this phone or Google Drive
No backup yet. Make one now so your records are safe if this phone is lost or damaged.
A passphrase is set. Backups are encrypted with it.
Set a backup passphrase first. Every backup is encrypted with it.
Backups are encrypted with this passphrase and you will need it to restore. If you forget it, the backups cannot be opened — not by you and not by anyone else. Write it down and keep it safe.
Use something different from your login password
Only encrypted backup files are stored, in a hidden folder that only this app can see. No business data is kept anywhere else.
Restore from a file on this phone
No backups in Google Drive yet.
No safety backups on this phone.
Use the passphrase that was set when this backup was made.
Replace the data on this phone?
Everything on this phone will be replaced by the backup. A safety backup of the current data is made first and kept on this phone, so you can go back.
I understand the current data will be replaced
Your data was restored. Sign in with the password that was in use when the backup was made.
The backup could not be applied, so nothing was changed. Your data is exactly as it was before.
No internet connection. Connect and try again.
Google Drive needs your permission again. Tap Connect Google Drive.
Your Google Drive is full. Free some space or back up to this phone.
That location cannot be used. Choose another folder or file.
Not enough storage on this phone. Free some space and try again.
This backup is damaged and cannot be restored.
This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Please update the app first.
This file is not an Egg Business Manager backup.
The restore was interrupted, so nothing was changed.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Back up automatically to Google Drive
Set a backup passphrase and connect Google Drive to turn this on.
Saved to Google Drive, in a hidden folder only this app can see.
Older automatic backups are deleted from Google Drive. Backups you make yourself are never deleted.

Android decides the exact moment to save battery, so the backup can run later — for example once the phone has a network connection and enough battery. A backup already made in this period is not repeated.
Battery saving may delay automatic backups on this phone.
Another backup or restore is running. Try again in a moment.
Delete this backup from Google Drive?
The backup from %1$s will be removed from your Google Drive. This cannot be undone. Your data on this phone is not affected.
You restored this backup with its passphrase, so you can choose a new login password now without the old one.
This option is only available right after restoring a backup. Use Forgot password instead.
